title: Equipment rental and personal storage
goal: Tell apart two similar tags and apply the right issuance rules. The photo is an AI-staged demonstration.

steps.title: Personal storage tags and equipment rental tags
steps.note: Distinguish the approved rules for the blue-tray storage tags and the yellow-tray equipment rental tags.
steps.instruction: The tags in the blue tray are for personal storage. The tags in the yellow tray are for shared equipment rental. Storage tags cannot be used to borrow equipment.
steps.completion_check: Issue an equipment rental tag if either completed training or supervisor accompaniment is confirmed. If neither is confirmed, do not issue a rental tag. Issue a storage tag only after receiving the personal item.
